profile.name: Vu Doan
profile.summary: Software engineer with 5 years on the frontend at a UK fintech, working in React, Svelte and TypeScript. Builds developer tooling that speeds up the team, and brings hands-on Node.js and PostgreSQL experience from personal projects, with a strong interest in backend work.

experiences.summary: UK fintech building financial management software for the superyacht industry.
bullets: Build and maintain the production frontend in React, Svelte and TypeScript, including the shared Storybook component library, delivering features and fixes against release deadlines.

Built FE Quick Dev, a VSCode extension (TypeScript, Node.js) on the Visual Studio Marketplace that serves local builds into the live app, cutting a 3–10 minute deploy-to-test cycle to a near-instant rebuild. Used by all 5 frontend engineers, and by a backend engineer moving into frontend work.

Prototyped and pitched two further developer tools: interaction-2-test, an open-source Storybook addon on npm that records UI interactions and generates Jest tests, and a Bitbucket Forge app that triggers deployment pipelines automatically on push.
Built Go and GraphQL services and a Python test-data generator for a group project: an A&E patient-wristband management system.

education.institution: University of the West of England, Bristol
education.notes: Creative coding (p5.js), web development and interaction design.
